Title: Force a fresh Netlify production deploy after reconnect
Problem / Request: Netlify was reconnected to GitHub after the merged PULSE-027 commit did not trigger a production build. Create a new harmless public-site commit so the restored connection receives a fresh main-branch event.
Acceptance Criteria: The PR rewrites the approved index.html, privacy.html, terms.html, and netlify.toml bundle without visible content changes; the new merge commit is based on current main; Netlify production status attaches to the new commit and deploys from main; Pulse Vermont remains the live design; no public ride booking, payment, secret, Runtime Lite, or production-data change; CI passes; no automatic merge.
Branch / Build: Builder v0.4.8-netlify-public-bundle installed; run after Netlify GitHub reconnection.
